scripts.dev: npm run build -w @openrpg/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @openrpg/shared" "npm run dev -w @openrpg/server" "npm run dev -w @openrpg/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @openrpg/shared && npm run build -w @openrpg/server && npm run build -w @openrpg/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @openrpg/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
